correctness.rationale: For q>=2, all-length one-symbol deletion shadows restricted to palindromes: inserting a FIXED letter into a word yields at most one palindrome. Therefore even palindromes form an edgeless graph, and distinct odd palindromes sharing a descendant have different central symbols. Fixed central-symbol families provide q^m codes at length 2m+1, while cliques of q words with identical m-letter half force <=q^m; even length 2m gives q^m all palindromes. Different outer symbols in an odd conflict force two opposite-phase alternating palindromes; equal outer symbols reduce to length n-2. Thus the graph recursion is q smaller copies and one bridge for each unordered outer pair, giving e_m=q e_(m-1)+C(q,2) and e_m=q(q^(m+1)-1)/2. Independent word-shadow construction corroborated every graph edge and formula for q=2 n<=13, q=3 n<=9 and q=4 n<=7. The lemmas, not those finite tests, establish arbitrary n,q.
